name: Kenco American Standard DC - Hutchins TX

fieldNotes.truckGate: The entire dock yard is enclosed by a continuous chain-link perimeter fence on all four sides (confirmed in 2026 Street View on the S, W, and E faces). Truck access is through sliding gates in that fence. Kenco's published scope for this site explicitly includes 'spotter and yard management' and 'contract security', confirming a controlled, access-managed yard.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No dedicated 1-3-car guard booth is visible at any gate in the available imagery. Classified false; flagged uncertain because 'contract security' is contracted - a guard may be posted at a gate not clearly resolved.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: True - controlled truck gate but no identifiable guard booth (kiosk / app / posted-security check-in).
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Very large ~625,000 SF building with dock doors on all four faces and trailers backed in around the entire perimeter; well into the 50+ band (estimated ~130 doors).
fieldNotes.dropArea: Extensive trailer drop yard - long rows of unhitched trailers parked at the north end and around the building; 50+ band, large capacity (~200).
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: Deep paved dock aprons (~50-60m) on every face provide ample internal truck stacking.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: Single very large warehouse on its own parcel; adjacent warehouses to the west are separate properties - multipleFacilities false.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Hutchins industrial park south of Dallas off I-45, edge-of-metro with farmland nearby; classified Rural per the small-town-industrial tie-breaker.
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail spur enters the property.
fieldNotes.facts: 801 E Wintergreen Rd: ~625,000 SF Dallas-area DC for American Standard Brands (kitchen/bath products); Kenco runs finished-goods distribution, repackaging, toilet-kit packaging, spotter & yard management, contract security, MHE.

citations.claim: American Standard Brands awarded Kenco management/operation of its 625,000 SF Hutchins TX DC (801 E Wintergreen), incl. yard/spotter management
May 2024 LIXIL (American Standard parent) release: Kenco still manages the Hutchins TX DC; 14+ year relationship, given more LIXIL volume

verification.rationale: Kenco operates the ~625k SF Hutchins DC for American Standard Brands (now LIXIL Americas); May 2024 LIXIL release confirms the contract is current and expanding; active 2026 Hutchins hiring; no negative.
